adapter_binding.known_observability_limit: The frozen adapter translates both connect-path TimeoutError and response-read TimeoutError into the same ModelProviderError message. Latency Stability 001 therefore establishes persistent timeout behavior but does not localize the failing network/API layer.

claim_ceiling: Bounded localization of one NVIDIA provider-path incident only. No semantic correctness, canonical meaning, Institutional IR, production readiness, provider-wide availability, cross-provider reliability, architecture change, or independent-validation claim.
classification_boundary: Classification localizes the bounded incident observation only. It does not reclassify Latency Stability 001 or Qualification 006 and does not authorize Qualification 007 or Ontology 006.

diagnostic_sequence.purpose: Resolve integrate.api.nvidia.com and record terminal resolver outcome and returned addresses.
Open one TCP connection to the resolved NVIDIA host on port 443 and record connect latency/outcome.
Perform one verified TLS handshake with SNI and record protocol/cipher/certificate-host validation.
Send one deliberately unauthenticated request to the documented chat-completions route. Any bounded HTTP response establishes route/gateway reachability; no successful inference is requested.

Send one authenticated but deliberately malformed chat-completions request designed to terminate at request validation before model inference. Record HTTP status, headers timing, and terminal outcome.
Send exactly one frozen BASIC_TEXT provider probe against the target model while separately timing connection establishment, response headers, and response-body completion.

next_authorized_activity: Implement, test, materialize and statically freeze the incident diagnostic instrument offline. Do not execute incident diagnostics live yet.
scientific_question: At which bounded provider-path layer does the NVIDIA path fail: DNS resolution, TCP connection, TLS handshake, HTTP route/gateway, authenticated request validation, or the target chat-completion inference/response path?
stop_rule: If DNS, TCP, or TLS fails, no later provider diagnostic is executed because downstream layers are not reachable. If HTTP_ROUTE fails by timeout/transport error, AUTH_VALIDATION and TARGET_BASIC_TEXT are not executed. If AUTH_VALIDATION demonstrates explicit credential/account rejection, TARGET_BASIC_TEXT is not executed. No failed diagnostic is replaced or retried.
